headline: UBS may cut 12,000 Swiss jobs if capital rules tighten
summary: UBS could eliminate up to 12,000 jobs in Switzerland if regulatory capital requirements are tightened.
why: UBS is a leading global wealth manager and Switzerland's largest bank. Changes to capital rules directly impact its operational structure and cost baselines.

impacts.name: UBS Group
impacts.why: Stricter capital rules increase compliance costs, while potential job cuts mitigate operational overhead.

why_moved: Prospects of large-scale structural adjustments and regulatory headwinds directly influence institutional equity valuations.
